memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: independent with ADLs, walks unaided around home, manages florist shop with occasional help.
cognition: Mini-Cog score 3/5 (recall 1, clock draw normal) – negative screen.
falls: no falls in last 12 months, gait steady, timed up-and-go 10 seconds – normal.
medicines: 0 regular currently; will start supplements.
mood: reports feeling well, denies low mood or anxiety.
carers: daughter Priya, lives nearby, assists with shopping.
goals: "Stay active and keep my shop open as long as possible."

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Haemoglobin 9.8 g/dL (12-16)
Serum ferritin 12 ng/mL (15-150)
MCV 78 fL (80-100)
CBC: WBC 6.2 x10^9/L, platelets 210 x10^9/L
Stool routine: ova and parasites nil, occult blood negative
tTG-IgA <2 U/mL (negative) – coeliac screen negative

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Refer to gastroenterology for IBS symptom review and consideration of further dietary advice. Patient consents.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: continues florist work 3 days/week, reports mild fatigue after long walks.
cognition: Mini-Cog score 2/5 (recall 0, clock draw abnormal) – positive screen, plan for full MoCA assessment.
falls: one fall at home 3 months ago (tripped on rug), no injury, gait slightly unsteady, timed up-and-go 13 seconds – raised fall risk; advise home safety, proper footwear, strength exercises.
medicines: ferrous sulfate 200 mg OD, mebeverine 135 mg BD, ispaghula husk 5 g OD, loperamide PRN – 4 regular; polypharmacy not yet, review against Beers not required.
mood: admits occasional worry about falling, denies depression.
carers: daughter Priya assists with home safety checks.
goals: "Keep walking safely and stay independent."
